comments.author: paul
comments.body_html: isnt this just a rip -off of keepyourstartinggear? what the difference?

comments.author: gorecreek
comments.body_html:
Keep Starting Gear is similar but I do not intend to compete with it. It has something more like a save system, while this mod is a simple starting gear restore mod plus durability/lost items feature on top of it.

Also, I was using Keep Starting Gear some time ago and had issues with it. I had a specific set of features that I wanted in mind and just decided to implement them myself.

comments.author: gorecreek
comments.body_html:
The implementation is also different: KSG consists of a client mod that creates the “saves” on demand and a server mod that uses them to restore the inventory.

This mod on the other hand is just serverside and restores the inventory based on the information available at the end of a raid.

comments.body_html: i encountered a issue i looted a helmet and dropped my old one in raid and my old one didn get restored after death

comments.author: gorecreek
comments.body_html:
Hello! If you did not change the default config, then this is expected. The items you consumed or dropped intentionally are not restored by default. Only items that you had equipped on death are.

If you want all your items to return, consumed or dropped, change restoreLostItems to true.

comments.author: gorecreek
comments.body_html:
This mod’s code is just a callback on raid end. If your inventory was modified before the raid finished, then the code will treat it as if you dropped the items yourself, because it wouldn’t know how they were lost. Patching this would probably require a client mod that tracks items and it isn’t really worth it imo.

This is with FIKA, right? I don’t know of any other mods that could cause this situation. Glad to know it works in other cases.

Thanks for the feedback!
